Daily (AKA Dark Blue):
Birthday: June 1, 2012
Color: Dark Blue
Info:
The main character of the show. A colored pencil who is ambiverted, a great outside-the-box thinker, has skipped a grade and records his life on a website called "scratch".

Green:
Birthday: June 27, 2021 (ah so thats why he's so dumb...)
Color: Lime
Info:
Daily's foreign exchange student from Ohio. Not much to say other than when he took an IQ test, he exited it because he thought it was a scam. Despite him 3 minutes later scamming 400$ out of Daily's parents bank account due to him clicking a scam for winning a MacBook. (dont worry, they got the money back due to Red giving them 400$).

Red:
Birthday: January 1st, 2012.
Color: Red
Info:
Daily's friend from across the street. He is very introverted, easily entertained or irritated. Recently he has found a legal-loophole that allowed him to gain 200,000$.
